EV QuickSmart Mobile is an essential tool for simultaneously configuring, controlling and monitoring up to six Bluetooth™-equipped Electro-Voice portable loudspeakers, including EVERSE 8, EVOLVE 30M/50/50M, and ELX200 series. Using BLE connectivity, you can adjust EQ settings, gain, preset, and crossover parameters – all while in front of your PA system. You can even mix your entire show on the fly from your device when using mixer-equipped speakers such as EVOLVE 30M/50M. Signal and limiter status indicators – as well as notifications for connection loss and input clip events – give you the assurance that you’re treating your system well during a performance. Make quick adjustments to multiple speakers at once with dynamic component grouping, and locate your speakers in a dark performance space with LED identification.

With EV QuickSmart Mobile, you can now take full control of your system with your phone or tablet. Control your sound from where you are, not where the knob is!
